subject: Logic
title: Loaded Questions
description: A micro-lesson that makes Loaded Questions usable.

hook.text: "Have you stopped cheating on exams?" Answer yes or no—either way, you just admitted to cheating.

buildup.text: A loaded question smuggles in an assumption that hasn't been established or agreed upon.

discovery.text: "Why does your company ignore customer complaints?" assumes ignoring happens before the answer starts.

twist.text: The trap is the question's framing. Answering it on its own terms validates the hidden assumption.

climax.text: Refuse the frame. "I reject the premise of that question" strips the trap of its power.

punchline.text: Challenge the question, not just the answer.

quiz.question: What does a loaded question contain?
